::: {#exm-postorder}
#### Postorder of $B$

The postorder (@def-postorder) of the binary tree $B$ of @exm-binary-tree is the list

$$
c, j, h, f, p, r, w, t, m.
$$

Each vertex comes after all of its descendants (@def-descendant).
So postorder is the order to use when the work at a vertex needs the results from its subtrees,
such as finding the size of each subtree, or deleting the files in a folder before the folder.

:::
